A '''farseein''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] device that used an oil magnifier lens to see objects from great distances, similar to [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]]. The device was somewhat burdensome as it had a base that would rest on the chest of the user.

==Behind the scenes==

"Farseein" looks and is even structured similarly to the German word ''Fernsehen'', which means television and literally translates to "far-see".
